question: A Cisco Nexus 7000 Series switch runs VXLAN, and interface Ethernet 7/30 is configured as a trunk port. Which command set configures the switch to act as a gateway for VLAN 507?
context:
interface Ethernet7/30
  no switchport
  no shutdown
  service instance 1 vni
  no shutdown
  encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 default
options: encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 50 vni 500 bridge-domain 50 member vni 500 interface Bdi50 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 500 vni 50 bridge-domain 500 member vni 50 interface Bdi500 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 500 vni 50 bridge-domain 500 member vni 50 interface Vlan500 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
